context: Aoi and Riku talk about a band's new release.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: music chat; fan vocabulary (ファン/メンバー/演奏/放送) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あのバンド、新曲を公開したよ!
lines.en: That band released a new song!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: わたし、あそこのファンなんだ!
lines.style: thrilled barista voice, soft warm bubbly delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: メンバーが、一人増えたんだって。
lines.en: They added a new member, I heard.
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 新しいメンバーの演奏、聴いた?
lines.en: Did you hear the new member's playing?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、演奏がすごく上手だった。
lines.en: Yeah, the performance was really skilled.
lines.style: impressed teen boy voice, bright warm admiring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今夜、ラジオで放送されるよ。
lines.en: It airs on the radio tonight.
lines.style: excited barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ファンとして、絶対聴かなきゃ!
lines.en: As a fan, I absolutely have to listen!
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, bright warm determined delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 放送の後、感想を言い合おうね!
lines.en: After the broadcast, let's share thoughts!
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm bubbly delivery throughout
